description: Archi helps you discover and compare products through interactive recommendations and product cards featuring sourced prices, retailer links, key specifications, and trade-offs. It organizes research gathered in ChatGPT and displays available merchant-provided coupons without guaranteeing prices or savings. You can explicitly submit a discount request for a selected product for manual review, with an outcome sent by email.

defaultPrompt: Find 43-inch 4K smart TVs under £400, compare key specs and trade-offs, and show any available merchant coupons.
Compare noise-cancelling headphones for commuting, including prices, comfort, battery life and any available merchant coupons.
Find cushioned running shoes under £150. Compare fit and drawbacks, with video reviews where available.
